rationale: The message reports concrete observed behaviors for cat and fixlengths commands from probing, without proposing or requesting work. It delivers test results/implementation behavior details, so evidence_observation is primary and result_delivery secondary.

evidence.text: cat rows uses first header only, ignores subsequent headers. cat columns combines all headers (a,b,c,d) and pairs data rows up to minimum by default; --pad extends.
fixlengths computes max record width incl trailing? input header a,b; row 1; row 2,3,4 => outputs a,b then 1, then 2,3,4 (does not pad header to max); --length 2 truncates/pads each data incl header.
